message.text: Keep the fridge and freezer doors closed. With doors closed, food stays safe about 4 hours in the refrigerator, 48 hours in a full freezer, and 24 hours in a half-full freezer. After 4 hours without power, move perishable food from the fridge into a cooler with ice. Never taste food to check it.
